# English Requirements Quality Checklist: API, UI and User Experience

**Purpose**: Unit tests for English — validate that requirements in `spec.md` for API contracts, role/branch-aware navigation, dashboard, Kanban/detail, design system and SignalStore are well-written: complete, clear, consistent, measurable and unambiguous in English before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are stable API contract requirements documented for every resource (DTOs, envelope, filter/sort/search) without leaking internal entities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are optimistic concurrency requirements specified for all mutable resources (ETag/version, 409/412, currentVersion in ProblemDetails)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are validation requirements defined for both field and business-rule layers with 400 ProblemDetails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are all 12 minimum views plus 4 auxiliary routes enumerated with purpose and deep-link reachability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Are hierarchy/role requirements for navigation visibility documented with permission + subtree source? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Are all Dashboard KPI requirements (My Projects/Team/Sub-Managers, Overdue/Blocked/Critical/At Risk/Completed, AI/Document Reviews) specified as subtree-filtered? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Are Work Item Detail section requirements (description, responsible, manager, status, progress with explanation, metrics, subtasks, dependencies, documents, history, comments, gated AI) listed completely? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are token/elevation/component requirements from `minimal-ui-design-system` references enumerated (colors, typography, spacing, radius, flat vs shadow-elevated)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is pagination quantified with explicit envelope fields `items, total, page, pageSize, Link` and bounds 1..100? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK010 Is "stable contracts" clarified to mean DTOs separate from internal `Entity/AggregateRoot`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK011 Is "optimistic concurrency" clarified with specific mechanism (ETag/If-Match or version field) and stale response codes 409/412? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK012 Are vague UI terms ("intuitive", "consistent", "prominent") replaced or quantified (e.g., elevation tier, token values)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK013 Is SignalStore usage clarified with required features `signalStore/withState/withComputed/withMethods/withProps/withEntities/withHooks/rxMethod/switchMap` and prohibition of `BehaviorSubject`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Is "explanation link" for progress quantified as revealing weighted indicators per Spec 004, not an arbitrary number? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §XII]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Are API error requirements consistent (always `ProblemDetails` via `Result→HTTP`, never raw entity/stack trace) across FR-001/FR-002/FR-003? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK016 Do role/branch hiding requirements (UI hides) align with server-authoritative enforcement (every command/query re-validates via `IManagementHierarchy`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §R7]
- [x] CHK017 Are pagination/sort/filter requirements consistent between FR-011 (delegated to API) and FR-012 (every list honors contracts)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK018 Are Kanban state-machine requirements consistent with Spec 014 (Backlog→…→Completed) and API 409 revert? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK019 Are tenant/organization-aware requirements consistent across all list, dashboard and search specs (always `tenant_id`+subtree before fetch)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §XV]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK020 Can pagination acceptance criteria be objectively verified (envelope fields + Link header + 200 vs ProblemDetails)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK021 Can concurrency criteria be measured (95% stale edits surface 409/412 and preserve edits via Reload/Merge in E2E)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK022 Can role-based navigation criteria be verified (4 roles × 12 views E2E with 403 on direct API)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK023 Can subtree-accuracy criteria be measured (two managers disjoint branches, seeded data, 0% leakage)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK024 Can design-system criteria be objectively audited (100% components use tokens/elevation from skill references, no hard-coded hex/shadow)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are primary scenario requirements documented (list with pagination, role-aware nav, manager dashboard, Kanban drag, detail with progress)? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1-4]
- [x] CHK026 Are alternate scenario requirements covered (filter/sort/search delegated to API, mobile collapsed nav, concurrent edit with switchMap cancel)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Are exception/error scenario requirements defined (400 validation, 403 forbidden, 409/412 concurrency, 500 mapped to ProblemDetails toast)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-001, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK028 Are recovery scenario requirements addressed (stale version Reload/Merge without data loss, pagination beyond total returns empty, retry on ProblemDetails error)? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Are non-functional scenario requirements specified (tenant isolation 0% leakage, hierarchical depth unbounded, design token fallback)? [Coverage, NFR, Spec §FR-014, §SC-008]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK030 Is behavior specified when `page=999` beyond total (empty items, total unchanged, no Link)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Is stale version race defined for simultaneous edits (second submit gets 409 with currentVersion, UI offers Reload)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK032 Are unbounded-depth hierarchy requirements defined (manager managing managers 5 levels) without hard-coded depth? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK033 Is fallback defined when design token is missing (use skill default, not hard-coded hex)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is unauthorized deep link handling specified (Contributor pastes `/admin` → redirect to dashboard + API 403, no flash)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK035 Are performance requirements quantified or explicitly deferred (list <300ms p95, dashboard subtree <500ms, route <100ms)? [Gap, Spec §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK036 Are security requirements complete (least privilege, deny-by-default, no IdP DB access, ProblemDetails without leak, oroidentityserver via access_token)? [NFR, Spec §FR-015, §XIX]
- [x] CHK037 Are accessibility requirements defined for interactive elements (keyboard nav, focus states) or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK038 Are observability requirements specified (logs/metrics/traces via ServiceDefaults for API, error signal in SignalStore for UI)? [NFR, Spec §XVIII]
- [x] CHK039 Are accessibility/color-contrast requirements for design tokens defined or intentionally deferred? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK040 Are dependencies on SPEC-002…008, IManagementHierarchy subtree, oroidentityserver claims, and BuildingBlocks documented and validated? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK041 Is the assumption of external oroidentityserver Podman integration validated (no IdentityDbContext, token only)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

- [x] CHK043 Are assumptions about WorkItem state machine and ProgressExplanation reuse from Spec 004 documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK044 Is "12 views minimum" unambiguous on whether additional auxiliary views (Search, Organization, Project/Document Detail) are required or optional? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK045 Do dashboard KPI requirements conflict between "My Team" (all subtree members) and "My Sub-Managers" (only direct manager children) — are definitions distinct? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006]

- [x] CHK047 Is a requirement & acceptance criteria ID scheme (FR-001…SC-008) consistently applied for traceability? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
